scientific_interpretation: The adapter-on arm produced no completed experiment result before its campaign deadline.
The adapter-off arm completed Experiment 1 internally but did not complete the preregistered factorial experiment before its campaign deadline.
The adapter-off recurrence curve is non-monotone and lacks an equal-compute baseline, so it is not evidence of a recurrence gain even in isolation.
Because the arms do not contain the same completed paired cells, no adapter effect, frontier gain, regression, or equivalence estimate is valid.
